question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

A national holiday _______ on the same day as my birthday.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e.** 'Falls'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **blank requires **a verb that indicates the occurrence of a national holiday on the same day as the speaker's birthday.
 
• **"Falls"** is the correct word, as it means to occur or take place.
 
• **Other options** such as "flows," "false," or "fouls" do not fit the context.
 
• Thus, the appropriate word to fill the blank is **"falls."**

Therefore, the **correct answer **is-** 'Falls'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Flows **(बहना) - Refers to movement, usually of water; not suitable here.
 
• **False** (झूठ) - Means not true; does not fit here.
 
• **Fouls** (गंदा करना) - Refers to making dirty or entangled; irrelevant in this context.
